name: kalima
description: Kalima, a familiar-script privacy veil for webpages, Obsidian notes, and tmux panes.

scripts.package:release: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:obsidian && npm run package:tmux
scripts.check: npm run check:extension-bundles && npm run check:packages && node --check browser-extension/content-bundle.js && node --check browser-extension/google-docs-bundle.js && node --check browser-extension/shared/core.js && node --check browser-extension/shared/state.js && node --check browser-extension/shared/gregg.js && node --check browser-extension/google-docs-main.js && node --check browser-extension/content.js && node --check browser-extension/background.js && node --check browser-extension/popup.js && node --check browser-extension/options.js && node --check scripts/lib/release-archive.mjs && node --check scripts/package-chrome.mjs && node --check scripts/package-tmux.mjs && node --check tmux-plugin/lib/terminal.js && node --check tmux-plugin/bin/kalima-filter && node --check tmux-plugin/bin/kalima-setup && node --check tmux-plugin/bin/kalima-view && sh -n kalima.tmux tmux-plugin/kalima.tmux tmux-plugin/bin/open-setup tmux-plugin/bin/open-view && node --check tests/extension-smoke.mjs && npm run check:obsidian
